hallucination_risk: MODERATE-HIGH — multiple security-critical UNSURE items in auth design

rejected_alternatives: Session-based (express-session + Redis) — adds Redis dependency, not RESTful
JWT-only no refresh — forces frequent re-login, poor UX
OAuth2 full flow — overkill for internal admin dashboard
API keys — not suitable for user-facing login
design_plan.adopted_approach: JWT access token (short-lived, 15min) + refresh token (long-lived, 7d, stored in httpOnly cookie or DB)
implementation_plan: 1. POST /login: validate credentials, bcrypt.compare, issue access+refresh tokens
2. POST /refresh: validate refresh token, rotate (issue new, revoke old), issue new access
3. POST /logout: revoke refresh token in DB
5. Access token: 15min, in Authorization: Bearer header
6. Refresh token: 7d, in httpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie
UNSURE_items: Should refresh tokens be stored hashed (SHA-256) or as random opaque strings?
@fastify/jwt v9 exact API for refresh workflow?
Is argon2 preferred over bcrypt in 2025?
Refresh token rotation best practice: revoke entire family or just the used token?
httpOnly cookie vs Authorization header: which is current best practice for SPAs?
risk_list: Refresh token stored in localStorage → XSS vulnerable
Access token too long-lived → no revocation window
Refresh token reuse → need rotation + reuse detection
Password hashing: bcrypt vs argon2 — which is current best practice?
Token blacklist not implemented → cannot force logout
CSRF if refresh token in cookie without SameSite
dependency_choice: bcrypt or argon2 for password hashing
refresh_tokens table in DB with user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked
